core_obligations: Factor both rings: choose a polynomial presentation of the source algebra and base change it to obtain the corresponding presentation of the base changed algebra (proof lines 4691-4692)
Reduce by double base change: the identification of the two ways of tensoring up shows that it is enough to construct the map for the remaining polynomial ring step (proof lines 4693-4696)

Construct and identify: use the base change map constructed in the trivial duality section for the two presentations, and conclude it is an isomorphism in the bounded below case from the corresponding statement for surjections (proof lines 4696-4706)
proof_roadmap: 取分解 R → P → A（P 为多项式环），基变换得 R' → P' → A'。
由 double-base-change：(K ⊗_R^L P) ⊗_P^L P' = (K ⊗_R^L R') ⊗_{R'}^L P' ⇒ 只需对多项式环这一步造映射。
用 §base-change-trivial-duality 里构造的映射 (equation-base-change)，并在 K ∈ D^+ 时由 flat-bc-surjection 知它是同构。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement produces a functorial base change map between the upper shriek along a finite type map and the upper shriek along its base change along a flat homomorphism of Noetherian rings, and asserts it is an isomorphism on bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 4677-4688, label lemma-flat-bc). The proof (source lines 4690-4707) chooses compatible polynomial presentations of both algebras, reduces through the double base change identity to the polynomial ring step, and exhibits the map supplied by the trivial duality section, whose isomorphism in the bounded below case comes from the surjection statement (proof lines 4696-4706). The reduction and the identification of the map are the substance. H3.
